roleDescriptions.platform_admin: Operates the platform; access is logged.
roleDescriptions.owner: Everything, including billing and transferring ownership.
roleDescriptions.admin: Manages members, settings, integrations and all leads.
roleDescriptions.sales_manager: Sees all leads, assigns them, imports/exports and views reports.
roleDescriptions.sales_agent: Works on the leads and tasks assigned to them.
roleDescriptions.analyst: Read-only access to leads and reports.

definitions.newLeads: Leads created inside the selected period.
definitions.notFollowedUp: Open leads with no call, email, meeting or WhatsApp logged yet (all time).
definitions.qualified: Leads that entered the Qualified stage or a later stage during the period.
definitions.wonLost: Leads moved to Won / Lost during the period, whenever they were created.
definitions.lost: Leads moved to Lost during the period, grouped by the reason given.
definitions.conversionRate: Cohort conversion: of the leads created in the period, the share that is now Won.
definitions.firstResponse: Time from lead creation to the first logged call, email, meeting or WhatsApp.

leads.duplicatePolicyHint: Saving follows your organization's duplicate rule (Automations → Lead intake).
leads.dncBody: Scheduled follow-ups for this lead will be cancelled and marketing messages blocked. Use this when the customer asks not to be contacted.
leads.allowContactBody: Only do this if the customer has agreed to be contacted again.
leads.dncWarning: This customer asked not to be contacted. Only log contact they initiated.
leads.closeStopsFollowUps: Open automated follow-ups for this lead will be cancelled.

leads.noNextStep: No next step scheduled for this lead.
leads.notePlaceholder: Write a note for your team…

import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
import.empty: The file has no data rows.
import.tooManyRows: Import up to 5,000 rows per file.
import.mapHint: {file} · {rows} rows. Tell us which column holds which field.
import.mapContact: Map a Phone or Email column.
import.mapDuplicateField: Each field can only be mapped once.

pipeline.readOnly: You can view the pipeline but not move leads.

tasks.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Call to confirm the viewing
tasks.automated: Created by an automation; cancelled automatically if the lead is won, lost or opts out.

ai.title: AI insights
ai.disclaimer: Suggestions only — kept separate from the confirmed lead data until a person reviews them.
ai.needsReviewHint: Low confidence. Please check before acting on it.

updatedReason.duplicate_merged: New submission merged into this lead

automations.subtitle: Ready-made automations powered by n8n. Each one runs only for your organization, and every run is logged.
automations.noRunsForLead: No automation has run for this lead yet.
automations.logsPrivacy: Logs keep step results and errors only — never full customer data.

lead_ingestion.name: Lead intake
lead_ingestion.description: Validates new leads from any source, normalizes phone/email and applies your duplicate rule.

lead_assignment.name: Smart assignment
lead_assignment.description: Assigns new leads to an active salesperson using your chosen strategy.

first_response_sla.name: First-response alert
first_response_sla.description: Alerts the owner when a new lead hasn't been contacted in time.

stale_lead_follow_up.name: Stale lead follow-up
stale_lead_follow_up.description: Creates a follow-up task when an open lead goes untouched.

stop_on_close.name: Stop follow-ups on close
stop_on_close.description: Cancels automated follow-ups when a lead is won, lost or opts out.

ai_classification.name: AI qualification
ai_classification.description: Classifies the inquiry, extracts needs and suggests priority and next step.

daily_report.name: Daily report
daily_report.description: Emails managers a short summary of yesterday's leads, follow-ups and conversions.

summary.stale: Create a task after {days} business day(s) without an update
summary.stop: Always on when enabled — no settings

config.dedupePolicy: When a lead matches an existing one

policyHint.merge: Add the new message to the existing lead; never overwrite curated fields.
policyHint.flag: Create a new lead and mark it as needing review.
policyHint.reject: Refuse the new lead; the source gets a duplicate error.

strategyHint.specialty: Match the lead's area/service to an agent's specialties, then fall back to round robin.
strategyHint.manual: Leave new leads unassigned and notify managers.

config.assignmentRules: Inactive members never receive leads. If nobody is available, managers are notified. Each lead is assigned once even if events arrive at the same time.
config.slaDisclaimer: A target, not a guarantee: alerts depend on system and integration availability.
config.minConfidenceHint: Results below this are marked “Needs review”.
config.aiPrivacy: Only the message text is sent to the AI provider — never phone numbers or emails. Messages are treated as data, not instructions.

integrations.subtitle: Start with the sources your team actually uses. Credentials are stored encrypted on the server and never shown again after setup.

website_form.name: Website form (webhook)
website_form.description: Receive leads from your website's contact forms through a signed webhook.

email.name: Email provider
email.description: Send notifications and daily reports from your own address.

csv_import.name: CSV import
csv_import.description: Bring in your existing leads from Excel or another CRM.

google_sheets.name: Google Sheets
google_sheets.description: Sync leads to or from a spreadsheet.

external_crm.name: External CRM
external_crm.description: Keep leads in sync with the CRM you already use.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Book follow-up meetings directly in your calendar.

whatsapp_business.name: WhatsApp Business Platform
whatsapp_business.description: Official WhatsApp messaging with approved templates and customer consent.

ad_leads.name: Ad lead forms
ad_leads.description: Receive leads from supported advertising platforms.

integrations.disconnectBody: New events from this source will be rejected until you connect it again. Existing leads are not affected.
integrations.askAdmin: Ask an admin to change this integration.
integrations.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now — for security it won't be shown again. If you lose it, rotate it.
integrations.allowedOriginsHint: One per line. Requests from other origins are rejected.
integrations.rotateWarning: Saving creates a new secret. Update your website before the old one stops working.
integrations.emailHint: Use an address on a domain you've verified with your email provider.
integrations.genericConnect: Connect this integration to start syncing.

rules.secrets: Secrets are encrypted at rest and never sent to the browser again.
rules.dedupe: Each event carries an id, so a retried delivery never creates a second lead.
rules.retry: Failures are logged and retried safely from Execution logs.

reports.subtitle: Where your leads come from, how fast your team responds, and what closes.
reports.funnelHint: How many leads created in the period reached each stage

types.lead_assigned: A lead is assigned to me

settings.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
settings.organizationHint: Shown to your team and used for reports.
settings.businessHoursHint: First-response alerts only run inside these hours.
settings.membersHint: Invite people and choose what they can do.
settings.inviteExpiry: Invitations expire after 7 days and can only be used once.
settings.demoInviteLink: Invitation link (shown in demo mode only):
settings.deactivateHint: Deactivated members are signed out immediately, can't sign in and never receive new leads. Their history stays.
settings.specialtiesHint: Areas or services this agent handles (used by the “By specialty” assignment strategy).
settings.rolesHint: Default roles. The server enforces these on every request.
settings.pipelineHint: Drag to reorder, rename stages, or create a task automatically when a lead enters a stage.
settings.pipelineRules: Rules: at least one open stage, exactly one Won and one Lost stage, max 12 stages. A stage with leads can't be removed until they are moved.
settings.sourcesHint: Where your leads come from. Used in filters and reports.
settings.sourcesRule: Sources that already have leads are deactivated instead of deleted, so reports stay correct.
settings.sourceDeactivated: Source has leads, so it was deactivated
settings.notificationsHint: Choose how you hear about events. These are your personal settings.
settings.notificationsRule: These preferences only affect alerts to you; they never override a customer's contact consent.
settings.billingHint: Your subscription and this month's usage.
settings.billingNote: AI, email and messaging provider costs are billed according to your agreement.
settings.auditHint: Who changed permissions, exported data, deleted records or changed integrations.

profile.changePasswordHint: Changing your password signs you out on every other device.
profile.sessionsHint: Devices currently signed in to your account.
